notes.title: Train Station Renovation - Germany DLC Coming Soon!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

Train Station Renovation - Germany DLC is coming to Steam soon! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38216048/f5800c7319a5f58b2e22dab9376fcf2e6e2afb1c.png

We are happy to announce a brand new DLC for our other game - Train Station Renovation! 

Our colleagues at TSR Team have recently been working extra hard and this particular addition is a fruition of their love for the game - if you've ever played Train Station Renovation you will feel right at home in the DLC with new stations awaiting your arrival!

In this particular addition you will be able to renovate 6 additional stations that were inspired by stations you can find in Germany - hence the title of the DLC. It is also our nod to our great TSR community from which many of you come from Germany itself! We hope you will be able to feel the spirit of the country when doing the work necessary to bring the stations back to their former glory!

And if you haven't yet tried Train Station Renovation it might just be the best moment to do so! Not only will you be able to enjoy a relaxing gameplay that you may fall in love with but also as soon as you finish you can start another journey in Germany!

Be sure to stay tuned in for more information coming soon - including the release date!

Renovators - a new chapter in your career will begin soon!

Best regards,
Train Station Renovation Team

notes.title: Supermarket Manager - Devlog #9 - ”Maintenance”
notes.content:
Hello Managers!

If you want your Supermarket to always look great you need to take care of it!

Maintenance is something that you need to perform regularly! Telling yourself "I'll do it tomorrow" is a short road to making your market fall apart! Diligence and hard work always bear fruits even if at first it's very difficult to force yourself to follow a certain schedule. Customers will, however, take notice of your venue being in peak condition at all times!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38216048/594820062e2a0f36cb247e4c133a3057acc61b5e.png

Broken floor can not only look bad but can also be a health hazard. Your customers will definitely feel better walking around clean and safe place. Thankfully you will be equipped with tools that will help you maintain the right conditions for your place. It might cost you extra however can you really put a price on the image you'll be creating with your actions? 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38216048/9d386d09a325160595638f7a3d271f6fb78311f0.png

It's easy to forget about cleaning shelves but if you don't do it the effects will show up quite easily. Nothing makes customers more unwilling to buy than seeing that what they are buying were put in a dirty container or fridge. Don't make that mistake and be sure to always do due diligence. 

Thank you for checking in with us this week - see you next time!

Best regards,
Supermarket Manager Team

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38493800/3275740acc70c627275e89ee73f2cec9575f4e27.png

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1355060/Supermarket_Manager/

notes.title: Open beta testing is coming!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

As you might know Live Motion Games hosts a variety of interesting projects that we are proud to work on.

We are happy to say that day by day we make progress on each of them getting closer and closer to the release date of each of the particular games we work on. Our teams are busy as bees, as they say, but the enthusiasm within them is steadily growing - easily translating into creation of many great features that you will be able to test soon. 

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36301902/061f2d8fa45988cd2b486e4570022c36b4b66b0d.png

And speaking of testing - some of our projects still are accepting the sign-ups for the playtests that will happen directly on Steam. Below you'll find the list of games that are included in the play-tests project that will happen in future. 

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36301902/3e438a16e1826f5440e32ef4860fad71249e8ee6.jpg

Builder Simulator - if you've ever dreamed about creating your very own house, exactly as you would like it to be then dream no more - Builder Simulator will allow you to do just that. It's a game dedicated to each of you who find joy in creation and execution of your own ideas. After all in the game you'll be able to go through every step of the construction process. 


https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36301902/ab561cf24f5653753231f04b3121cd8d59e556e0.jpg

Chernobyl Liquidators Simulator - is a project where we tackle the topic of the catastrophe that happened in Chernobyl in April, 1986. We are approaching the topic seriously and realistically - no monsters in game but instead you will have to work hard in order to contain the radiation, complete your tasks as Liquidator and work for the sake of others.


https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36301902/86c13bd835e81ab21f5354a82195d8b37d27f0f0.jpg

Builders of China - our take on the management type of game where you will be responsible for the well-being and development of different Chinese settlements. Your decision will influence establishing trading outposts, growth of the population and research in new technologies. Will you hold to the Mandate of Heavens? 


https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36301902/a83b2adcaa59a8d6c279ccd951f96658e3149680.jpg

Supermarket Manager - if you ever wanted to manage your own Supermarket - here is a chance for you. You'll be tasked with many duties including hiring your own employees, equipping the market or developing your store. Create the market you can! 


Currently we are happy to say that playtests for Chernobyl Liquidators Simulator will happen soon and shortly after them tests for Builder Simulator will follow. You might then expect our other games listed above to follow the suit in foreseeable future. 

We invite you all to join the playtests - it's a great opportunity to check the games before release and influence the way they are developed. We'll be looking into your feedback as much as possible when deciding on further functions and features. We'll also make sure to eliminate all bugs your reports will bring to light.

Thank you for your continuous support. We are blessed to have such a great community and we hope to bring you the best games! 

Kind regards,
Live Motion Games

notes.title: Supermarket Manager - Devlog #8 - ”Equipping your Supermarket”
notes.content:
Hello Managers!

So you would like to kick-start your Supermarket but you're lacking the equipment to do that? No worries, we've got you covered!

You've secured the place and even renovated all the elements that warranted repairing and fixing - great! Now comes another fun part of owning your own business - making sure that it is properly equipped! In case of Supermarket this might mean variety of things but let's focus on the easiest part - purchasing machines and furniture necessary for your establishment to flourish into a highlight of the city! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38216048/99b1c4aa7ca5e23ade87b4682d9c5607a478c14c.png

You'll be able - depending on the state of your finances - to purchase additional equipment - shelves, baskets, trolleys in order to make the shopping as comfortable for your customers as possible. Of course, Supermarket needs cash registers so those would be also available to purchase for you. As you can see you'll be also able to select from a wide choice of them - finding the one that would suit your own market best. Check their prices, colours and shapes to make sure that your decision is wise! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38216048/8d265a45345e9ff237bc36009517b5033fede3e6.png

Of course buying one might not be enough so purchase several of them! You'll need employees to man them but we've already talked about that in the devlog focused on employees and by now you know the drill! Of course everything costs money - that's how this world functions - so make sure to take into an account your overall budget and financial opportunities. Will it be okay to purchase whatever you want right now or perhaps in future? Maybe there is something more important that requires buying right now? 

Being Manager is making decisions - a lot of freedom but also hands full of responsibility! Take care!

Best regards,
Supermarket Manager Team

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38493800/3275740acc70c627275e89ee73f2cec9575f4e27.png

notes.title: Supermarket Manager - Devlog #7 - ”Own it, fix it, make it!”
notes.content:
Hello Managers!

Beginnings are often very difficult - remember though that good results come to those with good effort!

At the start of the game your market might resemble a site of some kind of tragedy even after just building it. Water leaking out of unfinished pipes, destroyed shelves and old products rotting in the corner, walls falling apart at the slightest touch... this all might be your reality in few first seconds after getting your own place however you should not start crying yet! Your fate is in your hands and so is the fate of the Supermarket! Get ready for some hard work fixing the place so it looks the best even to the most careful inspectors!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38216048/c417dfedf6ede36a173c4a30bd7c5e38bb1bc182.jpg

Let's get some new wall paint and change the shelves, then let's fix all the areas where it seems like time has struck and renovate it. All the boxes randomly laying around need to be rearranged and placed in their rightful corner or perhaps even thrown away? Needless to say we need to sweep the floors and make sure that all the equipment is usable - if it's not we'll need to throw it away and buy something new. All depends on you! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38216048/5801378da12f04d43473fe2f0638963429be4b97.jpg

Ah, now that's much better. Products neatly arranged on new shelves, some great posters and signs showing what kind of products will our customers be able to find in this particular alley. There is still some work to be done here but it looks much better than it used to. And that's the gist of it - small steps will take you higher and higher you simply cannot stop making them! 

You'll have to do your best in many areas but we know you can do it!

Best regards,
Supermarket Manager Team

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38493800/3275740acc70c627275e89ee73f2cec9575f4e27.png

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1355060/Supermarket_Manager/

notes.title: Supermarket Manager - Devlog #6 - ”Employment opportunities!”
notes.content:
Hello Managers!

While you're busy catering to your customers and making sure they're happy you cannot forget about the other important group of people - your employees!

HR Managers might know that the best but managing people is a difficult task. You always need to be careful what you say, how you behave, what kind of motivation system should you employ and so on. And it all starts very early - when you're selecting a right candidate for the job you need to be able to discern whether a person trying to get a job would be an asset for your Market or... perhaps you should keep looking. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38216048/f1c3e6ca2060a89e5275d2f981bc3d9c659c610f.png

When hiring employees you will definitely need to check what skills they have. Obviously, some people are more suited to a particular type of job, while others would excel at something different. Employee profile will allow you to check important details such as experience, skills and salary that the person applying is expecting. What do you think would be the best job for Victoria? You can check her profile on the screenshot above. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38216048/a63921357c7b00477aae2098d83c189316004e63.png

If you have several employees that are similar to each other you might want to check their salary expectations. As they are different it might be important to hire someone who would love to work for you for a lower wage than someone who is demanding riches! However be mindful - sometimes the employees might have more than one skill and seem valuable but if you will hire them for a wrong position it will not be too good for you. Experience is also an important factour. If you're dealing with someone who is just starting you might expect that some degree of on-site training will be mandatory while veterans might be able to start the job just fine! 

Employees will be the vital factour for the success of your Supermarket - don't ever brush them off!

Best regards,
Supermarket Manager Team

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38493800/3275740acc70c627275e89ee73f2cec9575f4e27.png

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1355060/Supermarket_Manager/

notes.title: Supermarket Manager - Sign up to participate in Beta Tests!
notes.content:
Hello Managers!

Sign-up for a chance to join the beta tests!

Being a manager means being open and welcoming all opportunities to excel. Sometimes the opportunities happen absolutely unexpectedly. Not so long ago we were talking with you about the possibilities to create a Supermarket exactly how you envisioned it. Many of you expressed the wish to play the game and how difficult it is to wait for the full release. Well… When life gives you an opportunity to join beta tests, join beta tests then! And that is exactly what we are going to let you do! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38216048/d983daa69540b64d5c12bda87c8528bc69a89f07.png
 
Starting from now on you will be able to sign up for a beta test on the main page of the game on Steam. In 2021 we will randomly select a few participants that will have the chance to test the game simply by playing through it. We are hoping to gather as much feedback from those lucky fellows as possible - all for the task of making our game the best it could be!

As it is a beta test you need to remember that some of the things might be still not fully implemented or might work in an inappropriate way. Please do remember that it is the nature of beta tests to find out what is working well and what is working… not quite as good. We’re hoping to hear back from you about any issues you might encounter during tests as we will be closely monitoring your suggestions, opinions and feedback. Your words are what matters the most! 

That being said we can’t wait to see you suited up and ready to manage your own Supermarket! The new era for the industry starts now and you need to make sure that your place is the best one around! 

Don’t wait - sign up for the beta right now!

Best regards,
Supermarket Manager Team

notes.title: Supermarket Manager - Devlog #5 - ”Customers are always right!”
notes.content:
Hello Managers!

Customers are the most important people you will meet during your career as a manager! Some of them might even demand to talk to you! Do you know why they are so important?

While building your own Supermarket and making sure it is exactly as you imagined it is easy to momentarily lose yourself in your own little world. It is however very important to remember that in the end it will be customers who will be the final judge of your achievements and your work. It will be them who will come barging to your market to find anything they might need and if they don’t find that - they will be angry. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38216048/056d619c0d3c9839f6f449761c571465ebfeb651.jpg

You need to carefully plan your market and manage your employees so they’re always on their best behaviour and helpful toward the customers. You need to act quickly if you see any problem arising in your object. You need to be always on the lookout for potential ways of improving yourself and your location. The work never ends - it’s a process, a gratifying and satisfying process when everything works like a Swiss clock but it can get sour pretty quickly if you stop giving it your 100%!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38216048/34a2181b81a14c04b5ed158e006b05be8796da8e.jpg

But if you manage to do well, if you manage to create a fantastic place - for your employees and for your customers - you might expect that it will always be bustling with happy people. It will never be boring - working in this kind of industry naturally invites many surprisingly pleasant and unexpectedly stressful moments and you need to be able to manage them all well in order to prepare a great place. A place many will come back to with a smile on their faces and that will be known for being welcoming and fun. 

Prepare yourself for many adventures while managing your place!

Best regards,
Supermarket Manager Team

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38493800/3275740acc70c627275e89ee73f2cec9575f4e27.png

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1355060/Supermarket_Manager/

notes.title: Supermarket Manager - Devlog #4 - ”Let’s build a market!”
notes.content:
Hello Managers!

Starting your own business can sometimes be rough, time-consuming and difficult… but at the same there’s nothing quite like seeing your vision slowly but surely being realized just like you wanted it to be.

Just think about it – people hard at work, doing exactly what you expect them to do, making sure that your Supermarket will be as you dreamed it...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38216048/015f9b2fa5f0d5dc379c8ac95100d86b57757ec7.jpg
 
We would love to give you tools and possibility to create and manage exactly the type of place that you wanted to. That is why the element of building in the game will be present and will be quite crucial. It will be you who will decide where to put that particular shelf and whether it is more sensible to place sweet in front of the store or more to the back. Your decision making and your responsibility!
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38216048/f3a5a9e95c8ff7652055903dbd0ed80341673e73.jpg

And then after all is said and done, the dust settles and you can start preparing for the opening? That will be the moment of the ultimate test because as we all know – it is the last few moments before the work is finished that seem to invite many ideas and possibilities. And you always need to be ready for everything!

Managing your own Supermarket is a complex job – also at a “ground” level!

Best regards,
Supermarket Manager Team

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38493800/3275740acc70c627275e89ee73f2cec9575f4e27.png

notes.title: Supermarket Manager - Devlog #1 - "Q&A"
notes.content:
Hello Manager,

Nice to meet you! 

This is our very first devlog from Supermarket Manager. 🥳 🎊

With this entry, we would like to introduce ourselves and answers the most important questions. 

[previewyoutube=23PjZw2lUi8;full][/previewyoutube]

 Who we are?

Simply said, players for players company.

We are an experienced team of polish game developers, comprised of all major specialties such as game and level design, programming, art, animation, or UI design. Most of our members have extensive game dev background and multiple released projects under our belts.

We would like to provide you with a possible best game. That's why your ideas, suggestions, and active participation is one of the most important factors in our opinion. 

⬇ Add game to wishlist to stay in touch with us ⬇

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35404032/f3970aa12831f8120a099837330625c35e257809.gif


 What you can expect from us?


From time to time we will be delivering fresh news about progress in game production.

 What's the Supermarket Manager?


It is a game where you manage your own supermarket. In the end, only time will tell whether you can save your business from bankruptcy and develop a successful, lasting supermarket brand.

In-game you will be able to:

 create a powerful brand 
 choose the identity of your store
 buy premises and equipment
 select products and employees
 balance income and expenses
 repair and improve the store
 gain new customers and increase your sales
 acquire unusual luxury products
